widgets_values:
# H3 REFERENCE DIRECTOR — WORKFLOW 01

**Four steps to a video**
1. **Group 01 — Models.** All four loaders must show a file. Download list: `H3_Reference_Director_01_v2.0_MODELS.pdf`.
2. **Group 02 — Reference bank.** Load your pictures, videos and audio.
3. **Group 03 — Prompt + video settings.** Paste your prompt, pick size and length.
4. **Queue.** The video is saved by **Group 05 — Output**.

**Optional**
- **Group 04 — LoRAs + speed.** LoRAs are OFF, live preview is ON.
- **Group 06 — Motion refine.** **Group 07 — Latent upscale.** **Group 08 — Face refine.** Each has one switch and is OFF.

**Group 09 — Engine** holds the nodes that do the work. You never need to open it.

Each black note explains the nodes next to it.

nodes.title: WHAT THIS WORKFLOW CAN DO
widgets_values:
# WHAT THIS WORKFLOW CAN DO

| Feature | Group | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Up to 9 pictures, 3 videos and 2 audio clips as references | 02 — Reference bank | — |
| LoRA Stack: 4 LoRAs + 2 of your own, each with a file picker | 04 — LoRAs + speed | all OFF |
| Speed Mode: full quality / Turbo 8-step / Turbo 4-step | 04 — LoRAs + speed | full quality, 20 steps |
| Live preview while rendering | 04 — LoRAs + speed | ON |
| Motion refine for fast movement | 06 — Motion refine | OFF |
| Latent upscale 1.5x | 07 — Latent upscale | OFF |
| Face refine for small faces | 08 — Face refine | OFF |

With every switch at its default the workflow renders one normal video. LoRA trigger words are added to your prompt automatically.

nodes.title: USING THE OPTIONAL GROUPS TOGETHER
widgets_values:
# USING GROUPS 06, 07 AND 08 TOGETHER

Each optional group works on the video named in its own **`source`** field. By default every `source` is `normal video`, so the groups run side by side on the same normal video.

To pass one result into the next, set the next group's `source`:

| Order | Group | Set `source` to |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 06 — Motion refine | (always the normal video) |
| 2 | 07 — Latent upscale | `motion-refined video` on **UPSCALE 1** |
| 3 | 08 — Face refine | `upscaled video` on **FACE 1** |

A group whose source group is OFF saves nothing. Every group keeps the original audio. Each extra pass adds render time, so switch on only what a clip needs.

nodes.title: GROUP 01 — MODELS
widgets_values:
# MODELS

| Node | Default file | Folder in `ComfyUI/models/` |
|---|---|---|
| **BACKEND — REF2VA MODEL** | `Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_Pruned_v1.3_int8` | `diffusion_models` |
| **BACKEND — H3 TEXT/VISION ENCODER** | `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq` | `text_encoders` |
| **BACKEND — H3 VIDEO VAE** | `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16` | `vae` |
| **BACKEND — H3 AUDIO VAE** | `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32` | `vae` |

**A loader shows an error or "not in list":** that file is missing or has another name. Put it in the folder above, press **R**, then pick it in the dropdown.

**Other base models** you can pick in **BACKEND — REF2VA MODEL**: the official `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot` and the Z-Image graft `MiniMax-H3-ref2va-pruned-zs05-comfy-int8`.

Links for every file: `H3_Reference_Director_01_v2.0_MODELS.pdf`.

nodes.title: GROUP 02 — REFERENCE BANK
widgets_values:
# REFERENCE BANK

Each loader's title says what that slot is for. Load only what your prompt uses.

**Optional slots** (Picture 8, 9, Video 1, 2, 3, Audio 2) are switched off (muted). To use one: select the node and press **Ctrl+M**. Press it again to switch the slot off.

**Video loaders (VIDEO 1 / 2 / 3)**
- `video` (bottom of the node): pick a clip, or use the upload button under it.
- `force_rate`: keep **24**.
- `skip_first_frames` / `skip_last_frames`: cut frames from the start / end.
- `frame_load_cap`: longest length in frames. 0 = all.
- `custom_width` / `custom_height`: 0 = keep the clip's size.
- The preview under the picker loops without sound. Move the mouse over it to hear it. It plays only the frames that will be loaded.

**Video 3 sound:** when no Audio 1 or 2 is active, the sound of Video 3 becomes the final soundtrack.

In your prompt, tag only slots that are loaded and switched on.

nodes.title: GROUP 03 — VIDEO SETTINGS
widgets_values:
# VIDEO SETTINGS

- **ESSENTIAL — H3-SAFE RESOLUTION PRESET** `preset`: use a **Test** preset for drafts, **H3 Native** for finals.
- **ESSENTIAL — EXACT DELIVERY LENGTH** `seconds`: the length of the saved video.
- **TEST — SEED** `noise_seed`: keep it **fixed** while you compare settings. Change it for a different take. Save the seed of a shot you like.
- **TEST — REFERENCE FIDELITY**: leave at `0.999` / `1.0`. Lower values give more freedom and more drift from your references.

nodes.title: GROUP 03 — PROMPT
widgets_values:
# PROMPT

Paste your finished prompt into **ESSENTIAL — CREATIVE PROMPT + SEMANTIC AUTO-REMAP**.

- Refer to references by their slot: `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 3>`, `<Audio 1>`. Use the numbers printed on the loaders in Group 02.
- Tag only slots that are loaded and switched on. A tag for an empty slot stops the render with "prompt references media that is not active".
- Do **not** type LoRA trigger words. Group 04 adds them.
- Describe what should be seen. The model has no negative prompt, so a list of things to avoid can make them appear.

nodes.title: GROUP 04 — SPEED MODE
widgets_values:
# SPEED — node **SPEED MODE**

| `speed_mode` | What you get | `steps` |
|---|---|---|
| `OFF - full quality` | best quality | 20 |
| `TURBO 8-step` | fast, good at 1344x768 | 8 |
| `TURBO 4-step` | fastest, best on the Test presets | 4 |

**`steps`** fills in by itself when you change the mode. Type another number to use it with the same mode: for example `TURBO 4-step` with 8, or `OFF` with 25. `0` means the mode's own count.

The turbo modes need their LoRA files (see the MODELS PDF).

**Live preview — node LIVE PREVIEW:** it is ON, so you see the video forming while it renders. It needs `taeh3.safetensors` in `models/vae_approx` and a current KJNodes. **If this node shows an error or the render will not start because of it:** download that file (see the MODELS PDF), or select the node and press **Ctrl+B** to switch the preview off. The video is the same with or without it.

nodes.title: GROUP 04 — LORA STACK
widgets_values:
# LORA STACK — node **LORA STACK**

Each LoRA has a switch, a strength and a `..._file` picker. All are OFF by default. One or two at a time work best.

| Switch | Use it for | Start | Trigger word |
|---|---|---|---|
| `realism_people` | natural people and skin | 1.0 (0.6–0.8 lighter) | `r34l1sm`, added for you |
| `motion_continuity` | sudden slow-motion, broken transitions | 0.9 | none |
| `spatial_physics` | objects only: collisions, falling | 0.4 | none |
| `lms_sharpness` | crisper detail | 0.8 | none |

**`..._file`** stays on `auto-detect`. If a LoRA is "not found" but the file is in `models/loras`, click this field and pick your file.

`custom_lora_1` / `custom_lora_2`: any other LoRA. Put its trigger words in `extra_trigger_words`.

Do not type trigger words into your prompt. This node adds them while that LoRA is ON.

If people show glitches with `realism_people`, lower it to 0.5–0.6.

nodes.title: GROUP 05 — OUTPUT
widgets_values:
# OUTPUT

**▶ OUTPUT — FINAL VIDEO / SAVE** saves the normal video to
`ComfyUI/output/video/H3_RefDirector01_v2/01_NATIVE…`

The optional groups save beside it:
`04_MOTION_REFINED`, `02_UPSCALED_1_5X`, `03_FACE_REFINED`.

nodes.title: GROUP 06 — MOTION REFINE
widgets_values:
# MOTION REFINE — for fast movement that smears or tears

It finds the fast parts of the finished video, stretches them in time, renders them again, and puts the clip back to its normal speed. The audio stays the original.

**Switch:** `enable_motion_refine` on **MOTION 1**.

**Strength:** `inject` on **MOTION 5**. `0.50` sharpens the motion and keeps the clip's structure. Lower (0.40) stays closer to the original. Higher starts to change the motion.

**How much is treated:** `preset` on **MOTION 2**. `d_max` (MOTION 2) and `dilation` (**MOTION 3**) set how far the fast parts are stretched. Keep the two equal. 3 is lighter than 4.

**Cost:** about two to three times the normal render. Try it first on a 5-second clip at a Test preset. A calm clip gains nothing.

If the background changes or an action doubles, lower `inject` to 0.40.

Needs the ComfyUI-MAINodes pack (the installer adds it).

nodes.title: GROUP 07 — LATENT UPSCALE
widgets_values:
# LATENT UPSCALE — 1.5x larger and sharper

**Switch:** `enable_upscale` on **UPSCALE 1**. `source` picks what is upscaled.

**Model:** `model_name` on **UPSCALE 2**. It needs the latent upscaler file in `models/latent_upscale_models`. **If this field is red,** your file has a different name: click the field and pick your file. The older name `minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16` and the newer `…_3d_conv_v1_fp16` are the same model.

**Detail:** **UPSCALE — REFINE STEPS / DENOISE**. `8` steps at denoise `0.20`. Lower the denoise (0.12–0.15) if the face changes too much.

**Look LoRAs:** **REFINE — LOOK LORAS** act only in this group and in Group 08 — Face refine. Leave them OFF unless you want a look added here.

The sound of the upscaled video is the original sound.

nodes.title: GROUP 08 — STRONGER FACE REFINE
widgets_values:
# MAKING IT STRONGER

Change one at a time, in this order:

1. `denoise` on **FACE — REFINE STEPS / DENOISE**: 0.40 → 0.50.
2. `denoise_multiplier_large_face` on **FACE 5**: 0.35 → 0.55. Large faces get little change by default.
3. `realism_people` in **REFINE — LOOK LORAS** (Group 07): 0.6–0.8.
4. `steps` on **FACE — REFINE STEPS / DENOISE**: 8 → 12.

Above about 0.55 denoise the face can drift, the mouth can stop matching the sound, and the edge of the refined area can show. If that happens, go back one step.

nodes.title: GROUP 08 — FACE REFINE
widgets_values:
# FACE REFINE — for small faces

It finds the face, renders it again larger, and puts it back.

**Switch:** `enable_face_refine` on **FACE 1**. `source` picks the video: normal, upscaled (Group 07 ON) or motion-refined (Group 06 ON).

**FACE 2**
- `detector`: `face_yolov8m.pt` in `models/ultralytics/bbox`.
- `select` = `largest_face`.
- `confidence`: lower it if a small or turned face is missed.
- `cut_detection`: set `none` for a single continuous shot.

nodes.title: GROUP 09 — ENGINE
widgets_values:
# ENGINE — you do not need to change anything here

These nodes do the work behind Groups 03–08. They are folded so they stay out of the way. To open one, click the small arrow or dot at the left of its title.

Columns, left to right: normal render · motion refine · latent upscale · face refine.

**If SageAttention is not installed on your PC:** select the six nodes with **SAGE** in their title and press **Ctrl+B**. The workflow then runs without the speed-up.

**For advanced tests only:** **TEST — SCHEDULER / STEPS / DENOISE** (`simple`) and **TEST — SAMPLER** (`res_multistep`). These are the validated values. The step count is set in Group 04, not here.

groups.title: 06 — MOTION REFINE · OPTIONAL · OFF BY DEFAULT · SWITCH: enable_motion_refine
07 — LATENT UPSCALE 1.5x · OPTIONAL · OFF BY DEFAULT · SWITCH: enable_upscale
08 — FACE REFINE · OPTIONAL · OFF BY DEFAULT · SWITCH: enable_face_refine
